summary: This clinical trial studies the drug semaglutide to see who benefits from it most for weight management and binge eating. Researchers want to understand how the treatment affects eating behavior and body weight over a period of six months. Participants will take the study drug, visit the clinic for checkups and tests, and wear a smartwatch while answering smartphone questionnaires. Universitaire Ziekenhuizen KU Leuven is sponsoring this research.
